founder.badge: Founding Director, Pi Global GCV Alliance
founder.name: Olivier Ndatimana
founder.quote: Based in Kigali, Rwanda, Olivier leads the Alliance's mission to connect merchants, entrepreneurs, and institutions across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA under one shared trade and consensus-value standard.
founder.bio: As CEO of Kigali Hot Market Ltd, Olivier's mission is to give every market participant — from smallholder producers to service companies — fair, direct access to a growing global trade network.

mission.heading: Mission & Vision
mission.missionText: To unite merchants, service providers, and institutions across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the USA under a single trade alliance — empowering every member with fair market access, priced fairly and payable in Pi at the community GCV target.
mission.visionText: A global marketplace where trade flows freely across continents — powering agriculture, manufacturing, professional services, and commerce for every alliance member, priced consistently at the community GCV target of 1 π ≈ ${{value}}.

membership.heading: Become a Member
membership.text: The Pi Global GCV Alliance is open to every trader, business, and institution. Whether you want to be an Ambassador, register your business as a GCV Merchant, or simply join the community — there's a role for you.
